snippet.title: Virtual Hunter - Official PlayStation VR2 Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the PlayStation VR2 Announcement Trailer for Virtual Hunter, a VR hunting game developed by Korpi Games and VRKiwi. Players can explore the great outdoors alone or with friends to hunt a variety of animals in an open-world VR environment. Make use of binoculars for scouting out targets, hunting rifles, bow and arrows, and more to get a clean shot. Virtual Hunter is coming to PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2) in 2025.
